narration: You get a bonus or tax refund — and 90% of us blow it all within 30 days. Here's what that habit is actually costing you over a lifetime.
visual: Money bag SVG springs in on dark background. Dollar counter animates from $4,200 down to $0. 'GONE. ALL OF IT.' fades in below in red.

narration: There's a name for this — the house money effect. Your brain marks windfall cash as 'not real money,' so your spending filter just switches off.
visual: Brain SVG on light background springs in. 'HOUSE MONEY EFFECT' badge fades in. Two labels: 'EARNED INCOME — FILTER ON' vs 'WINDFALL — FILTER OFF' animate in below.

narration: Between tax refunds, work bonuses, and gifts, the average American gets about $4,200 a year in found money. That's real wealth disappearing into nothing every single year.
visual: Three icons spring in on dark background: receipt (tax refund $1,450), envelope (bonus $2,150), gift box (gifts $600). Counter animates up to $4,200 total.

narration: Wealthy people use one rule — invest 50% of any windfall before spending a single dollar. The other 50% is yours to enjoy guilt-free. That's the found money rule.
visual: Gold coin SVG on light background. Two boxes appear: '50% INVEST NOW' in amber and '50% ENJOY IT' in dark. 'THE FOUND MONEY RULE' label appears below.

narration: Run the math — $2,100 invested every year at the market's historic 10% return. Over 30 years that turns into $340,000 from money your brain would've spent on nothing.
visual: Animated bar chart on dark background. Six bars grow sequentially: YR 5 ($12.8K), YR 10 ($33.5K), YR 15 ($66.7K), YR 20 ($120K), YR 25 ($207K), YR 30 ($345K). '$340K' fades in large below.

narration: One rule, $2,100 a year, $340,000 waiting at retirement. Follow for daily money moves that build real wealth from cash you'd normally spend without thinking.
